note: Held-out (state, tool_call) eval split. state = the exact D2 buildStatePrompt() text a LIVE gemini-3.5-flash run read; tool_call = the tool call it actually issued (real behavior, not a teacher-generated grounded label — see staticdata/extractAgentTraces.js). Contamination rule: the eval is held out ONLY IF the SFT trains on train.jsonl (the complementary ~80%), NOT on all rows. Deterministic stratified-by-source (live run_id): every Nth row by id within source -> eval. NOTE: 'press' (escape hatch) dominates the raw distribution (~80%) because manual battle/dialog mashing generates many turns per LLM call vs one macro call for goto/heal/fight_battle — this is the corpus's honest composition (outcome.status==='ok' only, no rebalancing), not a target ratio; address via curriculum/reward if it skews the trained model toward over-using press.
